review_locator: PMCID:PMC6387150, Interleukin-18 in Health and Disease; PMCID:PMC3792554, Interleukin-18 and IL-18 Binding Protein
primary_title: IL-18 and CD28 use distinct molecular mechanisms to enhance NK cell production of IL-12-induced IFN-gamma
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-18, in the presence of IL-12, increases IFN-gamma gene transcription in NK cells by nuclear run-on analysis.
limitations_preserved: Preserve IL-12 co-stimulation and NK-cell context; nuclear run-on supports transcriptional enhancement but not direct promoter occupancy, and IL-18 alone is not sufficient in this primary.
